queue_decision.reason: Verified latest REVIEWER WORK_REQUESTS exact PR/head; repair precedes new START.

defect.cause: Save-only optimistic revision CAS rejects later session B when older A saves first, discarding B's later progress.
defect.reproduction: Two complete canonical server fixtures share DataStore p:1; A and B load v1; A saves coins=300 first, B later tries coins=500. Previous head stores 300 and cancels B. Negative control pins previous PR94 head.

fix: Atomically claim a per-session GUID owner via UpdateAsync during validated load; later join supersedes earlier owner. Save checks both revision and owner, so old sessions cannot commit in either save order. New-profile claim reserves the key; malformed/read-failed/claim-failed sessions never write. Preserve DataStoreKeyInfo metadata/UserIds. No permanent lease: each valid rejoin can supersede, with failed concurrent claims fail-closed.
character_impact: No character stats/prices/combat changes; session ownership fences persisted Coins/Wave/Defeated/FactoryLevel.

tests.previous_rejoin_cases: 7 preserved; initial claim adds one legitimate UpdateAsync
tests.previous_conflict_cases: 7 preserved; GUID service injected in unmerged fixture

limitations: An earlier session's unsaved progress is not transferred to a later session; last claimed session is authoritative.
No periodic autosave; crash loss remains possible.
No live DataStore, Roblox engine or physical mobile proof.
next_action: Exact-head both CI jobs and new whole-server regression; separate REVIEWER decides main integration, then main QA/handoff.
